contexts.text: God blessed them ()... The Lord's blessing in the Word = fructification and multiplication, because these come from it. AC 55. AC 273.
The benediction referred to (). AC 2009.
God blessed () = the Lord's presence and grace. In the outward sense of the Word, to bless = to enrich with every earthly and bodily good.

Wherefore all who remain in the outward sense make the Divine blessing to consist in riches, in abundance of all things, and in self glory. But in the inward sense to bless = to be enriched with all spiritual and celestial good, and as this blessing can only be given by the Lord, to bless = the Lord's presence and grace. Explained.

Blessed be Jehovah the God of Shem () = all good for those who worship the Lord from inward things... Blessing involves all the celestial and spiritual good and also the natural which are signified by blessing in the inward sense. But in the outward sense blessing = all worldly, bodily, and earthly good. For these, however, to be a blessing they must be from inward blessing, for this only is blessing, because it is eternal, and is conjoined with all happiness, and is the very being of blessings...

It was customary with the ancients to say Blessed be Jehovah, by which they understood that all blessing is from Him, that is, all good. It was also a formula of thanksgiving. Illustrated. AC 1422:2, Illustrated. AC 3119.
I will bless thee () = the fructification of celestial, and the multiplication of spiritual things.

And thou shalt be a blessing () = that each and all things are from the Lord... Blessing is predicated of all good things; in the outward sense, of bodily, worldly, and natural goods; in the inward sense, of spiritual and celestial goods. To be a blessing = Him from Whom all things come, and Who gives all these good things.

I will bless them that bless thee () = all happiness for those who acknowledge the Lord from the heart. Blessing involves each and all things which are from the Lord, both good and true; thus celestial, spiritual, natural, worldly, and bodily things; and as in a universal sense blessing embraces all these things, it may be evident from the connexion what to bless signifies in each place, for it adapts itself to the things of which it is predicated.

It is here evident what to bless the Lord signifies, namely, to sing to Him, to evangelize His salvation, to preach His wisdom and power, thus to confess and acknowledge the Lord from the heart. They who do this cannot but be blessed by the Lord, that is, be endowed with those things which belong to blessing, namely, with celestial, spiritual, natural, worldly, and bodily good...
In thee shall all the families of the soil be blessed () = that all goods and truths are from the Lord.
He blessed him () = the enjoyment of celestial and spiritual things. To bless = to enjoy all good things.
The things contained in this verse announce the conjunction of the Lord's human essence with His Divine one; blessing itself involves this.
I will bless him () = the multiplication of truth. To be blessed = to be enriched with everything good and true. AC 2067.
I will bless him () = the multiplication of the Rational.
I will bless him ()... To be blessed = to be endowed with all good things.
In him shall all the nations of the earth be blessed () = that all who are in charity will be saved by Him. To be blessed = to be endowed with all good things which are from a heavenly origin.
Under Rain, see this reference, and at AC 7553.

In blessing I will bless thee () = fruitfulness from the affection of truth. To be blessed = to be enriched with celestial and spiritual good; here, to be made fruitful from the good of faith, or what is the same, from the affection of truth, because spiritual things are being treated of.
The Lord Himself could not be blessed, because He is blessing itself; but it is said that He is blessed when, in accordance with His love, they who are saved abound.

In thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed () = the salvation of all who are in good. To be blessed = to be enriched with celestial and spiritual good, and as these are they who are saved, to be blessed, here = to be saved. That to be blessed is an expression of wide signification is known. AC 3406. AC 4980.
Jehovah blessed Abraham in all things () = when all things were arranged in Divine order by the Lord... To bless, when said of the Lord's Human, has this signification. Explained.
The blessed of Jehovah () = what is Divine.
To bless, in bidding farewell (), was a devout wish for prosperity.

God blessed Isaac () = the beginning of the representation by Isaac. It was customary for the ancients to say to any work that was being begun, May God bless, and thereby was signified the same as by this votive expression, Be joyous and happy. Hence it is that in a more remote sense May God bless... signifies a beginning.
I will bless thee () = increase. To bless = to make fruitful in goods and multiply in truths, thus increase. AC 3440.

In thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed () = all who are in good both within and without the Church. To be blessed = to be made fruitful in good and to be multiplied in truths. AC 3578.
That my soul may bless thee () = adjunction to his own life, thus life corresponding to the Rational. To be blessed = to be endowed with celestial and spiritual good. AC 3986.

I will bless thee before Jehovah () = thus conjunction. I will bless thee = adjunction to his own life; here, as it is said, I will bless thee before Jehovah it = conjunction. Explained. AC 3522. AC 3530. AC 3553. AC 3565. AC 3569. AC 3576. AC 3586. AC 3591. AC 3596. AC 3597. AC 3605. AC 3660. AC 3667. AC 3670. AC 3679. AC 3682. AC 3709. AC 4284. AC 4297.
All blessing which is pronounced by the mouth goes forth from what is within, having life in it from the will and thought of him who blesses...
Blessed are they that bless thee () = that he who conjoins himself shall be conjoined.
Confession () = from the love of good; but praise and to bless = from the love of truth.
(Laban) blessed them () = joy thence derived. To bless = to wish prosperity, thus to testify joy as he is going away.
To be blessed (), in the inward historical sense = to be the representative of a Church.
Blessing here () = the things which are mentioned in the preceding chapter () which signify Divine goods and truths...

(God) blessed (Jacob) () = advancement to the interior things of the Natural, and the conjunction of good and truth there; for to bless is predicated of every good with which anyone is endowed by the Divine, especially concerning the conjunction of good and truth. References.

The blessing of Jehovah () = increase... In the genuine sense, the blessing of Jehovah = love to the Lord and charity towards the neighbour, for they who are thus endowed are called the blessed of Jehovah, for they are then endowed with Heaven and eternal salvation. Hence in the outward sense, or relatively to man's state in the world, the blessing of Jehovah is to be content in God, and thus with the state of honours and wealth in which one is...
As the blessing of Jehovah, or of the Lord, involves these things, blessing contains innumerable things in it. Enumerated.
The blessing of Jehovah, here = increase in good and truth, or in life and doctrine.
To water the mountains () = to bless those who are in love to the Lord.

Jacob blessed Pharaoh () = a devout wish for conjunction and thence fructification... To bless signifies many things. It involves all things which are good and prosperous in the spiritual sense. Enumerated. AC 6254.
(God Shaddai) blessed me () = a prediction concerning verification. Explained.
To bless = a prediction. AC 6275.
(A ritual of blessing.) AC 6292.
To bless () = to endow with truth and good.
To bless () = prediction; in the supreme sense, the Lord's foresight, and thus also Providence...

(Shaddai) bless thee with blessings of heaven above () = with good and truth from within. Blessings = the multiplication of truth and the fructification of good, for in the spiritual sense, blessing is nothing else. AC 6431. AC 6432.
To be blessed with blessings = to be endowed with such things as come from the Spiritual World.
He blessed them, each one according to his blessing did he bless them () = predictions concerning the spiritual life as to what would befall each one in such a state.
To do good to (), when said of God = to bless.
To bless () = to intercede.
Blessed be Jehovah () = that from the Lord is everything good... for with man blessing involves all the good of eternal life, that is, the good of love to the Lord and towards the neighbour. AC 8676.
Not considering that the Divine blessing consists in being happy to eternity...
Jehovah blessed the seventh day = that then comes the heavenly marriage from the Lord. To bless = to arrange in heavenly order, and to endow with the good of love.

I will come to thee and will bless thee () = the presence of the Divine and influx... To bless, when said by Jehovah = to endow with faith and charity, thus also to flow in, for faith and charity inflow with man from the Lord. These are blessing in the inward sense, for they are what render a man blessed and happy in Heaven. While a man lives in the world those things are called a blessing which render him blessed and happy in time...
Hence it is evident that blessing, in the spiritual sense, is that which has in it being from the Divine, thus the things of eternal life...
That worldly blessing is nothing relatively to the heavenly blessing which is eternal, Illustrated.

When a man is in such an order of life, gains and honours are blessings to him; but if he is in the inverted order they are curses. That all things are blessings when a man is in the order of Heaven, Illustrated.

(Jehovah) shall bless thy bread and thy waters () = increase of the good of love and truth of faith. To be blessed by Jehovah = to be made fruitful in goods and to be multiplied in truths, thus increase in such things as are of love and faith. References.
To be blessed () = to be endowed with the good of love and of faith, thus to receive the Divine which proceeds from the Lord. References.
To be waved by the priest = to be vivified for the reception of a blessing; for every blessing must have life from the Divine in it in order to be a blessing.
Good things, prosperity, and happiness, provided for man by the Divine, are eternal... thus are true blessings...

To give a blessing upon you this day () = the reception of Divine truth from the Word, and through it conjunction with the Lord. Blessing, in general = that which is given to man by the Lord; and as all this has relation to the good of love and truth of faith, these things and all that is thence derived are signified by blessing...

He who rightly considers the matter may know that high position and wealth in the world are not real Divine blessings... for they pass away, and also lead many astray and turn them away from Heaven; but that life in Heaven and happiness there are real blessings which are from the Divine. Illustrated. NJHD 270.
[Swedenborg footnote 2.]. Dignities and wealth are not real blessings, therefore they are conferred on both the evil and the good. References.
(Such) call wealth and high position blessings from the Divine, when yet they are not regarded by the Lord as blessings, but only as means for the life of man in the world. References.
As the natural man calls honours and wealth Divine blessings... DP 250.
Honours and wealth are blessings, and they are curses. General article.
Hence it is evident that dignities and riches with those who are in Heaven had been blessings in the world...
They are blessings with those who do not set the heart on them...
When dignities and wealth are blessings they are spiritual and eternal... General article.
The dignities and wealth which are curses relatively to those which are blessings are as nothing to everything, and as that which in itself is not to that which in itself is. General article.

And blessing () = all these things in Him and from Him in them. By blessing is meant all the good which a man has from the Lord, as power and wealth, and all that belongs to them; but especially all spiritual good, as love and wisdom, charity and faith, and thence joy and happiness; and as all these things are from the Lord, it follows that they are in Him... Hence it is that the Lord is called the blessed and also blessing, that is, blessing itself. Illustrated. AR 291.
To bless God, in the Word = to ascribe every blessing to Him, also to pray that He will bless, and to render thanks that He has blessed. Illustrated.
To bless in the name of Jehovah () = to teach.
They cried, May there be a blessing...
An aromatic smoke filled the antechamber, which was a sign of blessing from Heaven.
As the ecclesiastical order ministers those things which... are of blessing...
Daily shall He bless him () = that he will be continually in the good of charity and of faith; for this is the Divine blessing. AE 328:18.

And blessing () = the acknowledgement and glorification of the Lord on that account, and thanksgiving that everything good and true are from Him, and thus Heaven and eternal happiness for those who will receive them. Blessing, when said about the Lord = acknowledgement... Illustrated. AE 344.
To bless () = worship from spiritual truths.
They who receive Divine good and truth from the Lord are called blessed. Illustrated, Explained.
Blessing, here, means spiritual blessing. Illustrated.
The Lord's blessing the bread, wine, etc. = communication of His Divine, and thus conjunction with them through the goods and truths signified by the bread, etc.
To bless himself () = to instruct himself in Divine truths and apply them to life.
To bless, in the opposite sense = to love evil and falsity, and to imbue them.
Blessing () = the reception of Divine truth and thence fructification, whence come happiness and eternal life.
The reception of Divine truth in the First Heaven is called blessing.
It was customary with the ancients to say Blessed be God... by which they did not mean a blessing for Him... for He is the Source of every blessing... but they meant that these are from Him with all.
Blessing () = the multiplication and fructification of Divine truth. AE 518:7.
Bless them that curse you... To bless = instruction.
Whom Jehovah shall bless () = influx from the Lord.
Obed Edom was blessed on account of the ark, because blessing from the goods of the world signifies blessing from the goods of Heaven.
